normalize_googletest_output: normalize googletest program output by converting line endings, removing file locations, stack traces, and timing info
generate_golden_file: generate a golden reference file for googletest output comparison by running test commands and writing normalized output
test_googletest_output: test googletest text output against a golden file, handling platform differences and unsupported test features
remove_test_output_matching_pattern: remove output of specified googletest tests from a test output string by matching test case or test names
run_googletest_command: run a googletest executable command in a subprocess with custom environment variables and return combined output
